function.name: search_turns
function.description: Search the raw conversation turns (exact messages with dates). Returns the 8 most similar turns.

function.name: search_facts
function.description: Search the extracted facts the memory system distilled from the conversation (each with the date of its session). Returns the 8 best matches.

function.name: list_sessions
function.description: List the conversation's sessions: id, date and first line.

function.name: open_session
function.description: Read one whole session transcript by its id (e.g. 'session_3').

function.name: answer
function.description: Give the final answer and stop.
